name: Tikbalang
description: A creature of Philippine folklore depicted as a tall, gaunt humanoid with the head and hooves of a horse, known for leading travelers astray in remote forested or rural areas.

aliases.name: Multo / bibit
aliases.meaning: Earlier Spanish colonial terms ('ghost', 'spirit') used for the same forest phantom

origin: Reported throughout the Philippine archipelago, particularly in mountainous and forested provinces of Luzon and the Visayas.
